# Abu Saleh — أبو صالح

A bilingual (Arabic RTL / English LTR) website for Abu Saleh Group, a Jordanian coffee,
fresh juice, milkshake and dessert brand founded in 1991.

## About

- Founded: 1991, Amman, Jordan, by Mr. Mohammad Burghol
- Cuisine: fresh juices, milkshakes, ice cream, desserts, crepes, waffles, specialty coffee
- Presence: 14 branches in Jordan, 5 in Saudi Arabia, 1 in Turkey
- Contact: info@abusalehgroup.com · +962 (6) 4200-050

## Sections

- `/` — hero beverage carousel and highlights
- `/menu` — searchable, filterable menu of 110 products with Arabic and English names and JOD prices
- `/story` — company history, mission, vision and values
- `/locations` — verified branch finder with map directions
- `/contact` — phone, email, address, business hours and contact form

## Data sources

- Official menu feed: https://menu.abusalehgroup.com/menu/ar
- Official website: https://www.abusalehgroup.com/
